```yaml
name: Lint ObjC `new` Usage

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  lint-objc-new:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: Check for `[ClassName new]` usage
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Find ObjC files containing `[new]`
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "Searching for ObjC `[new]` calls..."
          # Find all .m and .h files, excluding AGENTS.md
          find . -type f \( -name '*.m' -o -name '*.h' \) -print0 |
            xargs -0 grep -n '\[.* new\]' > matches.txt || true

          if [ -s matches.txt ]; then
            echo "❌ Found `[new]` usage in the following files:"
            cat matches.txt
            echo "Please replace `[ClassName new]` with `[[ClassName alloc] init]`."
            exit 1
          else
            echo "✅ No `[new]` usage found."
          fi
```
